newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 2.

text.p: Following were the leading stories in Sri Lankan newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
An official of a private Sri Lankan bank taken into custody by detectives on charges of foreign exchange fraud.
Dumping of waste by industries along Kelani river from where Colombo's drinking water is pumped into a purifying plant is worse than made out to be, industry sources say.
Tamil Tiger rebel who took part in attack on three Army camps taken into custody from a boarding house in Colombo, police sources say.
Police Special Task Force patrol finds a 12 kg bomb during search operation in eastern Batticoloa.
